STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for goods and services contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.defined_by: clause 1.4 (“Threshold”) and Appendix B footnote *** item 2; values published on the Procurement intranet page
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for works and concession contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.defined_by: clause 1.4 and Appendix B footnote *** item 1
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for light touch contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.defined_by: clause 1.4 and Appendix B footnote *** item 3
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_APPLICABLE.description: “the relevant Threshold”: whichever of the three statutory thresholds above applies to the contract's category
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_APPLICABLE.defined_by: clause 1.4; used where the Rules say “the (relevant/appropriate) Threshold” without naming a category
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_APPLICABLE.note: Category-dependent selector, not a single figure. Resolve per contract from the three category parameters; do not give it a value of its own.

notes: VAT basis conflicts: clause 6.15 lists Value Added Tax as part of Total Contract Value, but the Appendix B table is headed “Total Value exclusive of VAT”. Threshold tests depend on which basis applies.
Placeholders left blank: the document title reads “Part [] Contract Rules” (p.1) and Appendix A row 3 refers to “Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)” (p.11).

Boundary gaps at exactly £500,000: clause 4.3 and Appendix A row 3 apply “over/Above £500,000” while Appendix A row 2 and Appendix B row B2 stop at “less than £500,000”, so a contract of exactly £500,000 falls in no Appendix A or B band (clause 7.4.2 'up to £500,000' does cover it for exceptions).

Boundary gaps at exactly the Threshold: Appendix B row B1 'less than the Threshold' vs row D 'Above Threshold', and Appendix C row E 'below the Threshold' vs 'greater than the Threshold', leave a contract valued exactly at the Threshold unassigned.

Appendix A row 4: the band is headed “£2.5million or more” but the cell says “in excess of £2.5million”; recorded as inclusive per the band heading. The cell also has incomplete drafting: “for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract”.

Waiver authority conflicts: clause 7.2.2 lets the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive waive competition at their discretion, while clause 7.3 says only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or exception.
Clause 5 numbering: the Transparency Code publication list in 5.1 continues as 5.1.1, 5.2 and 5.2.1, so 5.2 and 5.2.1 read as items of the 5.1 list rather than separate clauses.
Clause 6.11 refers to tenderers “from other member states” and cross-border interest, wording carried over from the EU regime; “potential cross border interest” is not defined.

Advertising wording differs in strength: clause 6.8 and Appendix B rows C and D say an advert “should” be placed, while clause 6.10 says above-threshold opportunities “must” be advertised on the CDP and Appendix B rows B1/B2 say a notice “must” be published.
Appendix C row C is missing a connective: “where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken” (p.14).
Appendix C row E (variation of scope) requires an “extension report” above the Threshold, wording that appears to be carried over from row D (extensions).
Appendix C closing sentence uses “an annual or total value”, a different basis from the full-duration Total Contract Value in clause 6.15.

Clause 7.4.2 reads “provided and an exception report has been approved” and clause 11.5.3 reads “in consultation with ... or nominated officer who must ensure the contractor’s status”; both are garbled but their obligations are still clear enough to test.
Clause 6.23 is a heading (“Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders”) with no text of its own.
Appendix B footnote *** (three statutory thresholds) has no marker in the table; it is the basis of the three threshold parameters.
Extraction artefact: pdftotext plain text prints “(CallIn)” in Appendix A row 3 because it drops a line-end hyphen; the quote uses the printed “Call-In”, which pypdf preserves.

rules.condition: procuring or arranging a service contract whose estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: Consider and record how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire under the Social Value Act and Social Value Policy.
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Ensure every contract is authorised by a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker acting within the Scheme of Delegation.
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or, within the Scheme of Delegation, an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate (4.1.1–4.1.3.3)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Confirm an existing budgetary provision in the Council-approved Budget before entering into the contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award valued over £500,000
rules.required_action: Take the award as a Key Decision of the Council.
rules.approver: Key Decision of the Council
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: any expenditure over £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors
rules.required_action: Publish details of all expenditure exceeding £500 under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015.
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for a goods and/or services contract valued over £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every invitation to tender for goods or services contracts valued over £5,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts in progress and awarded, showing value, duration and supplier.
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: contract information held by each service area
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board every month in the format the Procurement Legislation requires.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: any supplier awarded a contract for supplies, services or works
rules.required_action: Check that the supplier meets the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold, other than a Further Competition under a compliant Framework Agreement
rules.required_action: Advertise the opportunity on the CDP database before any other advertising medium.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc). However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.condition: any CDP notice
rules.required_action: Have the notice approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: any contract requirement
rules.required_action: Do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with an estimated value above the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders electronically through the Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: any electronic tender exercise
rules.required_action: Specify the electronic tender format in the Portal and ITT, and store tenders in a secure portal account locked until the opening time.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: a tender received after the time and date specified for opening
rules.required_action: Reject the late tender unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders are unopened.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Have a Procurement Officer open the tenders electronically, with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system.
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: evaluation of any quote or tender
rules.required_action: Evaluate quotes and tenders only against criteria notified to bidders in advance.
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: Award to the most advantageous, best-value quote or tender (not lowest price alone) unless the relevant Service Director approved an exception in advance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (exceptions, in advance)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: waiver of the competitive process on urgency grounds for a contract valued over £24,999.99
rules.required_action: Use the urgency ground only for contracts outside the Procurement Legislation where delay would likely cause financial loss, personal injury or damage to property.
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts which are not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules, the work, supply or service is required as a matter of urgency and a delay would be likely to lead to financial loss, personal injury or damage to property; or

rules.condition: waiver for a contract valued over £24,999.99 made at Executive Director and/or Chief Executive discretion
rules.required_action: Record in writing the reasons for any waiver made at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive.
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver of, or exception to, these Rules
rules.required_action: Obtain the waiver or exception from the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract valued up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer approve the exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer consult the Monitoring Officer and Executive Director, with an exception report approved by the relevant board in advance (retrospectively only for urgency under 7.3).
rules.approver: S.151 Officer in consultation with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director; relevant board approves the exception report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: exception for a contract valued over £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend the exception to the Executive, with an exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: the Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board and Corporate Board approve the exception report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver to these Rules (7.5)
rules.required_action: Fully document the exception or waiver.
rules.verbatim_quote: be fully documented;

rules.condition: exception or waiver for a contract where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Submit a written exception report with reasons to the relevant board in advance.
rules.approver: relevant board (report submitted by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service or Executive Director)
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: any exception or waiver to these Rules (7.5)
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval recording that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium or similar, 8.1)
rules.required_action: Before using the scheme, obtain advice confirming the Council may use it, the purchases fall within it and it complies with the Procurement Legislation and Council requirements (8.2.1–8.2.3).
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Produce a written report documenting the key decisions, steps and stages leading to the award.
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: the written award report required by 9.1
rules.required_action: Keep the award report for three years.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: documentation of any procurement procedure, regardless of value
rules.required_action: Keep the procurement documentation for three years from contract award.
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: any purchase
rules.required_action: Hold written (including electronic) evidence of the purchase.
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: any contract within Appendix B
rules.required_action: Put the contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer (form of contract)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract document sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Have Legal Services retain the sealed contract document.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: award of any contract
rules.required_action: Notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement of the award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register.
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued by the Monitoring Officer.
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: amendment of a Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: Have the relevant Service Director prepare the amended form and the Monitoring Officer or delegate approve it.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include a clause setting out the works, goods, services or things to be carried out or supplied.
rules.verbatim_quote: the works, supplies/goods, services, material, matters or things to be carried out or supplied;

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include a clause setting out the time within which the contract is to be performed.
rules.verbatim_quote: the time within which the contract is to be performed;

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include a clause setting out the quality requirements and standards to be met.
rules.verbatim_quote: the quality requirements and/or standards that must be met;

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include a clause requiring the contractor to hold and maintain appropriate insurance.
rules.verbatim_quote: requirements on the contractor to hold and maintain appropriate insurance;

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include a clause setting out the consequences of the contractor failing to comply with its obligations.
rules.verbatim_quote: the consequences of the contractor failing to comply with contractual obligations in whole or in part;

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include a clause requiring the contractor to comply with all relevant legislation, including equalities and health and safety.
rules.verbatim_quote: requirements on the contractor to comply with all relevant legislation, including (but not limited to) equalities and health and safety legislation;

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include personal-data clauses, informed by a completed Data Protection Impact Assessment.
rules.verbatim_quote: clauses regarding personal data and its use by the contractor and/or the Council respectively. Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: any contract (10.7: as a minimum, where appropriate)
rules.required_action: Include the Council's right to cancel and recover losses if the contractor acts improperly or commits a Bribery Act 2010 offence.
rules.verbatim_quote: the entitlement of the Council to cancel the contract and recover losses in the event that the contractor acted improperly (e.g. seeking to influence the Council to give the contractor any contract) or committed an offence under the Bribery Act 2010.

rules.condition: any contract (10.7.9 payment obligations)
rules.required_action: Include a clause requiring Council payment within 30 days of a valid, undisputed invoice.
rules.verbatim_quote: any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed; and

rules.condition: any contract (10.7.9 payment obligations)
rules.required_action: Include a clause flowing the payment obligations down to subcontracts and further subcontracts.
rules.verbatim_quote: any subcontract imposes the same obligations upon the subcontractor, and requires that the subcontractor imposes such obligations in any further subcontract.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Include enforceable specifications or technical requirements covering delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities in a contract
rules.required_action: Relax indemnities only with written authorisation from the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer (or their nominated officers), in writing
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: performance bond for a contract estimated over £500,000 for works, or for supplies/services by set dates (11.2)
rules.required_action: Use a bond form approved by Legal Services and include it in the Invitation to Tender.
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: contract within 11.2 (estimated over £500,000) where a performance bond is not considered necessary
rules.required_action: Undertake a written risk assessment.
rules.verbatim_quote: undertake a risk assessment in writing; and

rules.condition: contract within 11.2 (estimated over £500,000) where a performance bond is not considered necessary
rules.required_action: Obtain approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property for proceeding without a bond.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and

rules.condition: contract within 11.2 (estimated over £500,000) where a performance bond is not considered necessary
rules.required_action: Keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file.
rules.verbatim_quote: keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: contract whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Set adequate levels of insurance cover in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer set adequate levels of insurance cover (including employer’s liability, public liability and any other as determined by the needs of the particular contract);

rules.condition: contract whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Confirm the contractor holds the required insurances and keeps the policies current.
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer ensure that such insurances are held by the contractor and that the policies concerned are up to date (and/or renewed, as necessary, during the relevant period);

rules.condition: construction contract whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Confirm the contractor's status under the Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme.
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer who must ensure the contractor’s status under the Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme (for construction contracts);

rules.condition: contract requiring professional and/or design services
rules.required_action: Set a contract-specific level of professional indemnity insurance in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property set an appropriate level of professional indemnity insurance for each specific contract that require professional and/or design services (this should not be a standard level but be assessed on a case by case basis).

rules.condition: any document to which the Council's Seal is affixed
rules.required_action: Affix the Seal only to documents approved by the Council, Executive, an appropriate Committee or an officer with delegated powers.
rules.approver: the Council, the Executive, an appropriate Committee, or an officer with delegated powers
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal may be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document or proposal that has been approved by a resolution of the Council or Executive, or of an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.

rules.condition: any affixing of the Seal
rules.required_action: Have the sealing attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or a duly designated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: any sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Record each sealing as a consecutively numbered entry signed by the attesting person.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract valued above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Seal the contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: any document executed on behalf of the Council that is not required to be under seal
rules.required_action: Have the document signed by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer and recorded in the Monitoring Officer's register.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: selection and instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: Select and instruct Counsel only through the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: total contract value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Award under the delegated authority of the relevant Service Director or an officer they nominate in writing.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or officers nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: total contract value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Award by the relevant Service Director on S151 and Monitoring Officer recommendation, with a written report approved by the relevant board.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; written report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: total contract value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Take the award as a Key Decision with a board-approved written report, following the Call-In and Forward Plan procedures.
rules.approver: Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation of the Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; written report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: total contract value of £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: Obtain Executive approval, sought through the Executive's quarterly reports on contracts being procured.
rules.approver: the Executive (delegating award to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: total value (exclusive of VAT) above £1,000 and less than £25,000; no advertising mandated
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source.
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods and services, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold: award procedure
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: goods and services, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold: advertising requirement
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000: award procedure
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000: advertising requirement
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: goods, services, works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Follow the Procurement Legislation procedures with a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: contract excluded from competition under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process.
rules.verbatim_quote: Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for the extension
rules.required_action: Obtain S151 Officer approval for the extension.
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract (provided for, or permitted under the Procurement Legislation), contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract (provided for, or permitted under the Procurement Legislation), contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain relevant board approval after an extension report with Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer recommendation.
rules.approver: relevant board, on recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: social care placement or package contracts listed in row F a)–f)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual's case notes.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: any contract to which an Appendix C exemption is applied, with an annual or total value above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain relevant board approval for the exempted contract.
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.
